title: Boys Noize turns to the club (and an obscure Italian synth) for inspiration on 7LLVSION
description: If you're wondering how Alex Ridha's (aka Boys Noize) collaboration with Nine Inch Nails influenced his new record 7LLVSION, the answer is simple: It didn't. That's not to say Ridha didn't learn anything from the virtuosic production team of Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross, but most of the songs on 7LLVSION had been knocking around […]
